source.title: CICFlowMeter ReadMe.txt — List of extracted features and descriptions
source.evidence_location: Feature list, lines 384-512 in repository view
source.scope_note: Definitions describe CICFlowMeter feature semantics; they do not define maliciousness or a threat verdict.

features.name: Flow Duration
features.definition: Duration of the network flow, measured in microseconds.

features.name: Total Fwd Packets
features.definition: Total number of packets travelling in the forward direction of the bidirectional flow.

features.name: Total Bwd Packets
features.definition: Total number of packets travelling in the backward direction of the bidirectional flow.

features.name: Total Length of Fwd Packets
features.definition: Total size of packets travelling in the forward direction.

features.name: Total Length of Bwd Packets
features.definition: Total size of packets travelling in the backward direction.

features.name: Fwd Packet Length Min
features.definition: Minimum packet size observed in the forward direction.

features.name: Fwd Packet Length Max
features.definition: Maximum packet size observed in the forward direction.

features.name: Fwd Packet Length Mean
features.definition: Mean packet size in the forward direction.

features.name: Fwd Packet Length Std
features.definition: Standard deviation of packet sizes in the forward direction.

features.name: Bwd Packet Length Mean
features.definition: Mean packet size in the backward direction.

features.name: Bwd Packet Length Std
features.definition: Standard deviation of packet sizes in the backward direction.

features.name: Flow Bytes/s
features.definition: Number of bytes transferred in the flow per second.

features.name: Flow Packets/s
features.definition: Number of packets transferred in the flow per second.

features.name: Flow IAT Mean
features.definition: Mean time between consecutive packets in the flow; IAT means inter-arrival time.

features.name: Flow IAT Std
features.definition: Standard deviation of packet inter-arrival times in the flow.

features.name: Flow IAT Max
features.definition: Maximum packet inter-arrival time in the flow.

features.name: Fwd IAT Min
features.definition: Minimum time between consecutive packets in the forward direction.

features.name: Fwd IAT Max
features.definition: Maximum time between consecutive packets in the forward direction.

features.name: Fwd IAT Mean
features.definition: Mean time between consecutive packets in the forward direction.

features.name: Fwd IAT Std
features.definition: Standard deviation of time between consecutive packets in the forward direction.

features.name: Fwd IAT Total
features.definition: Total time between packets in the forward direction.

features.name: Fwd Header Length
features.definition: Total number of bytes used for headers in the forward direction.

features.name: Bwd Header Length
features.definition: Total number of bytes used for headers in the backward direction.

features.name: Fwd Packets/s
features.definition: Number of packets per second in the forward direction.

features.name: Bwd Packets/s
features.definition: Number of packets per second in the backward direction.

features.name: Min Packet Length
features.definition: Minimum packet length observed in the flow.

features.name: Max Packet Length
features.definition: Maximum packet length observed in the flow.

features.name: Packet Length Mean
features.definition: Mean packet length observed in the flow.

features.name: Packet Length Variance
features.definition: Variance of packet lengths observed in the flow.

features.name: PSH Flag Count
features.definition: Number of packets in the flow with the TCP PSH flag set.

features.name: Average Packet Size
features.definition: Average size of packets in the flow.

features.name: Avg Fwd Segment Size
features.definition: Average segment size observed in the forward direction.

features.name: Avg Bwd Segment Size
features.definition: Average segment size observed in the backward direction.

features.name: Subflow Fwd Packets
features.definition: Average number of packets in a subflow in the forward direction.

features.name: Subflow Fwd Bytes
features.definition: Average number of bytes in a subflow in the forward direction.

features.name: Init_Win_bytes_forward
features.definition: Total number of bytes sent in the initial window in the forward direction.

features.name: Init_Win_bytes_backward
features.definition: Total number of bytes sent in the initial window in the backward direction.

features.name: act_data_pkt_fwd
features.definition: Count of packets carrying at least one byte of TCP data payload in the forward direction.

features.name: min_seg_size_forward
features.definition: Minimum segment size observed in the forward direction.

features.name: Active Mean
features.definition: Mean time a flow remains active before becoming idle.

features.name: Active Max
features.definition: Maximum time a flow remains active before becoming idle.

features.name: Idle Mean
features.definition: Mean time a flow remains idle before becoming active again.

features.name: Idle Max
features.definition: Maximum time a flow remains idle before becoming active again.

features.name: Destination Port
features.definition: Destination transport-layer port for the flow. This is endpoint metadata, not a behavioral conclusion.
